sam-platform: Quick check — product wants the sampling rollout to be SLA-aware. Can we make the telemetry sampler lower priority on high-p99 latency routes so we don't violate customer SLOs?
maya-privacy: +1 we need rules that consider request latency + quota. Otherwise debug traces can push the tail over.
leo-engineer: Agree. Implementation thought: sampler should consult a routing-policy score that combines (route_latency_p99, current_gpu_util, tenant_quota_left). If score > threshold, enforce sampling_rate = min_rate.
sam-platform: That sounds right. Also need a console toggle per-tenant to opt into higher inspect sampling for enterprise customers (legal/audit).
ava-design: UX note — if we expose per-tenant toggle, surface the projected token cost and p99 impact before they enable. A tiny chart and an inline estimate should suffice. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maya-privacy: Security/legal require audit trail when someone flips that toggle. We need an immutable record (user, time, reason). Also TTL for temporary unmasking.
leo-engineer: Implementation sketch (pseudo):
```
if routing_score > SLA_THRESHOLD:
  sample_rate = global_min
else:
  sample_rate = route_config.desired_rate
```
And a fast-path: if tenant.has_audit_allowlist -> sample_rate = max(route_config.desired_rate, audit_min)
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary sampler-service v2 -> staging at 12:00 UTC. Reaction :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary started (staging) — 5 instances, obs: initial p99 stable.
sam-platform: Edge case we saw: bursty routes with small payloads still spike p99 because of downstream tracing. Do we want a separate cap on inspect payload size?
maya-privacy: Yes — clamp inspect capture to N chars and redact attachments by default. We should also HMAC IDs instead of storing raw identifiers.
leo-engineer: HMAC note: use per-tenant salt with rotation. That keeps linkage in logs but makes it non-PII externally.
ava-design: For the console, show a preview of the redaction result (sampled) with a warning banner. Small copy: "Preview shows an example redaction — actual logs are stored per policy."
sam-platform: Metrics to track during rollout: sampled_rate, sampled_cost_tokens, p99_latency_by_route, inspect_error_rate, legal_toggle_changes. Also alert if sampled_cost_tokens > budget_threshold.
maya-privacy: Add: a privacy-regression check in the CI that runs over a small seeded prompt set and fails if PII leakage score increases.
leo-engineer: Agreed — we'll add a feature flag to enable the SLA-aware sampler. Plan: feature-flag canary -> 48h staging -> 6h prod canary -> full. ops-bot: noted and will create rollout ticket.
sam-platform: OK, action items: 1) leo: implement routing_score hook + min_rate; 2) maya: define HMAC rotation policy + TTLs; 3) ava: mockups for console toggle and preview; 4) infra: schedule canary per ops-bot. Expect sync in 24h. :eyes:
